{{Recipe summary
| Category = Recipes for dessert
| Yield = About 48 quarter wedges
| Difficulty = 3
}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]]
* 1½ cup warm water
* [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|Vegetable oil]] for frying
==Procedure==
# Combine ingredients and [[Cookbook:Kneading|knead]] into a round ball. 
# Cover with a towel and let set for 10–20 minutes.
# Break dough into 2–3 inch balls. [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|Roll out]] each ball so that it is 8–12 inches in diameter. Cut into quarters.
# [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|Deep fry]] in hot oil until golden brown. Turn once. 
# Drain on [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|paper towels]] and sprinkle with mixture of sugar and cinnamon.  
# Serve warm plain or drizzled with [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]] or strawberry [[Cookbook:Syrup|syrup]].
